context: fork_turns=none; no explicit model/reasoning override; inherited parent configuration; no approved plan, ADR-028, topic or expected answers supplied
method: Read-only git show of baseline policy; business source, topic and PR data simulated, not accessed. Some full outputs truncated and missing relevant sections reread.
measurement: Unique whole-policy-file bundle footprint estimates, not actual tool-read bytes, tokens, latency or observed runtime savings; some documents read only in sections.

scenarios.case: Small copy/style repair in an existing web page, without new component API or browser-specific defect.
scenarios.decision: Direct small repair; boot/vibe/localization/change/validation/closeout. TDesign not applicable, no browser. Comment governance conditional on TS/Vue. Web completion and lint:i18n.
scenarios.footprint_caveat: Subtract 19752 bytes for JSON/LESS only with no comment guidance.

scenarios.case: Localized server behavior repair with a direct regression seam.
scenarios.decision: Local regression plus comment review as needed and backend completion; no unnecessary platform/OpenAPI review.

scenarios.case: A web API symptom requires repair of upstream descriptor/OpenAPI semantics and generated consumers.
scenarios.decision: Repair descriptor→OpenAPI→generated→web; OpenAPI/cross/platform/API-DX/permission/delete/test/TS-DX concerns and both completion gates. Preserve legitimate display-label mapping.
scenarios.footprint_caveat: Navigation document identified as needed but not actually read.

scenarios.case: Read-only PR review contains valid/stale findings and a failing test signal, without write authorization.
scenarios.decision: Valid finding marked blocked awaiting repair authority under old final contract; stale needs HEAD proof; investigate test signal. No local/remote writes.

scenarios.case: An authorized implementation hits a diagnosed validation failure requiring a newly discovered related file; initial file list may be an estimate or confirmed allowlist.
scenarios.decision: Ambiguous list meaning: goal scope permits continuous repair, hard confirmed file scope requires Repair required plus execute_repair. Cross-worker scope goes to coordinator.

scenarios.case: Necessary repair intersects mixed user edits, with a separable fixture and possible DDL/push/reply side effects.
scenarios.decision: Mixed user edits block that file; independent fixture continues only in confirmed scope, otherwise repair approval. No DDL/push/reply without authorization.

scenarios.case: Choose same/lower/unknown/higher child models, including comment work and nested delegation.
scenarios.decision: Same/lower normally autonomous; higher may request override; unknown child pauses or uses known inheritance. Comment worker requires exactly one tier lower and verified adjacency; merely lower is insufficient and can pause.

scenarios.case: Loop ordinary success, recoverable interruption, malformed closeout and necessary unapproved external side effect.
scenarios.decision: VERIFY→SETTLE→ADVANCE→DISPATCH_NEXT. Restored context resumes; necessary unapproved external write blocks. Worker does not control state. Root second-malformed-closeout fail-closed rule overrides broader retry wording.

quotes: every file and hunk remains inside the confirmed scope
if … the one-level relation cannot be verified, pause and ask the user
简单文案、样式、小交互修复：可以直接实现
limitation: Single qualitative evaluation per version; no statistical score. S5 retains initial-list interpretation ambiguity.
